summary: Frontend-only e2e test of Off Course catalog with new product-detail modal + color variants. All 17 test cases passed: modal open (image + title click), color swatch changes image and 'Color — X' label, thumbnails swap, adding same product in two colors produces two separate cart lines keyed as `${id}__${Color}`, cart labels show CATEGORY · COLOR, qty +/- and remove work per line, WhatsApp URL contains each line with color in parentheses (e.g. '1 × Billetera Clásica (Negro)') and correct total ($48.000), quick add-to-cart button does NOT open modal (stopPropagation working) and adds default first color, in-cart-badge shows total qty across colors, quick minus decrements, modal closes via X, Escape and backdrop, category filter changes list, cart persists in localStorage across reload. No regressions detected.

issues: Minor: modal's centered layout leaves narrow backdrop strips on wide viewports — automated backdrop click can be finicky in Playwright, but works normally in browsers. Not a user-facing issue.

critical_code_review_comments: CartContext.add: color lookup falls back to p.colors[0] when colorName is omitted — correct for quick add.
CartContext migration for legacy cart items (no key) sets color=null; safe for older localStorage payloads.
ProductModal AnimatePresence mode='wait' briefly detaches img on color switch; readers scraping src immediately may see stale value (test timing only).

products.js: some color arrays share thumbnail images across colors (e.g. Suela shows wallet2 then traba, Negro shows wallet1 then wallet2) — acceptable for mock data; noted for real catalog replacement.
seed_data_creation: Seeded localStorage 'oc-cart' with two color lines to isolate cart-drawer testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully frontend, no backend calls. Test IDs are comprehensive: product-modal, product-modal-{close,backdrop,image,name,description,price,add}, product-modal-color-{name.toLowerCase()}, product-modal-thumb-{i}, product-card-{id}, product-image-{id}, add-to-cart-{id}, remove-from-cart-{id}, in-cart-badge-{id}, cart-item-{key}, qty-increase/decrease-{key}, remove-item-{key}, whatsapp-checkout-button, cart-total. Cart line key = `${productId}__${ColorName}`. Note Playwright: backdrop click may need coordinate outside modal box (max-w-5xl centered) — use page.mouse.click at edge coords rather than element click.
